news.title: Introducing the Student Center, a new place for student connection, well-being, and success
news.summary_en: As students return to the Wright building, they’ll notice Room 2002 has become the Student Center, a place where they can connect, find support, prepare for their futures, and thrive. news.title: Graduate student turns waste into beautiful art and environmental action
news.summary_en: Reagan Kandole is currently pursuing a doctoral degree in the Arts Education program. His research focuses on community engagement and activism through the arts, particularly how arts-based interventions can encourage community participation, address social and environmental issues, and contribute to meaningful social change.
